summary: The RptMnuPlcSch_StudAssignSummary component is a web user control designed for generating student assignment summary reports within the HSPnet system. It includes various controls for selecting parameters and displaying options related to the report generation.
purpose: To provide a mechanism for users to generate detailed reports on student assignments, including contact information and scheduling data.

workflows.name: Generate Student Assignment Report
steps: FillProgramDropdown: Populate program selection based on department.
FillCohortDropdown: Populate cohort selection based on program.
CheckProgramPermission: Validate user permissions on selected program.
cmdRunReport_Click: Generate report based on selected criteria.
dsCampus_Selecting: Validate data source selection based on user session.
ddAddBlankEntry: Add blank entry to dropdown controls.

business_rules: AllowAllDepartments: Check user session for department permissions.
AllowAllPrograms: Check user session for program permissions.
validations: CustomValidator1: Validate selection criteria before report generation.
CustomValidator2: Display error if maximum report items exceeded.
calculations: MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS: Determine the maximum number of items to include in the report.
conditions: If UserSession null, cancel data source selection.
If department dropdown count < 1, populate departments.
If program dropdown count < 1, populate programs.
system_behavior: Managing dropdown data binding based on user session.
Configuring client-side scripts based on async postback status.
exceptions: Changes to auto-generated fields may be lost upon regeneration.
